text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, the leader rounds the fourth corner 
and enters the final stretch!! Which 
Umamusume will claim the glory of the 
Kikuka-sho—?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaaah...!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: (Hayahide...! What incredible spirit...!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: The victor of the BNW showdown is――!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UWAAAAAAAH--!!)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa...! Ughhh, I couldn't 
win...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: —Still!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Out of breath, Winning Ticket looked up at 
the spectator stands.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ticket-zo!! So close! But that was an 
amazing race!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
BNW really is the best~. I couldn't take 
my eyes off them!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UWAAAAAAAH--!!)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe, looks like I gave it my absolute 
best race!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, 1st place slipped right by me...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I felt deep down that we ran an 
absolute blast of a race!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The fans were so hyped up, it made all my 
hard work totally worth it!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Winning definitely feels way better 
than losing, after all!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Even so, Taishin and Hayahide are amazing!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Even during the race, the intensity 
radiating from the two of them sent 
shivers down my spine!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we'll keep having the best 
races forever and ever!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, have we decided on the next race 
yet? I really wanna run together with 
those two~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she's chosen in the fan vote, the Arima 
Kinen is a strong candidate, but it's 
still too early to say for sure.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, it might be good to 
aim for the Osaka Hai, the race that 
decides the strongest Umamusume in the 
Senior Class spring medium-distance 
division.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There's a very good chance that Narita 
Taishin or Biwa Hayahide will enter the 
race as well.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: The Osaka Hai! Yeah, I'm in!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight, I'll run with everything 
I've got in the Osaka Hai and entertain 
all my fans!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket fired herself up anew for 
her next target race, the Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There were two shadows quietly watching 
over her...
